title: CLI-Hub registry.json entry
description: One element of the `clis` array in registry.json / public_registry.json. The required-field set and category rule are taken from HKUDS/CLI-Anything CONTRIBUTING.md, then checked against every currently published entry. Optional fields such as source_url, install_cmd, contributors, package_manager, npx_cmd, platform, detect_cmd and install_strategy are allowed because upstream does not populate them consistently.

name.description: Lowercase registry identifier; upstream uses hyphens and underscores. Must be unique across both registries.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown on the hub.

version.description: Version as published. Common values include semantic versions, 'latest', and 'bundled'; the registries do not enforce SemVer.

description.description: One-line description of what the CLI does.

requires.description: Runtime dependencies the user needs, or null.

homepage.description: Homepage of the target the CLI operates on.

source_url.description: Standalone repos: URL to the repo. In-repo harnesses: null.

install_cmd.description: Full install command. CLI-Hub's installer dispatches on this: a pip/uv/git+ URL or npm package is required for it to know how to install.

entry_point.description: CLI command name on PATH after install. cli-hub verifies this exists when installing.

skill_md.description: Path or URL to the canonical SKILL.md; null only if not yet available.

category.description: One of the categories present in registry.json / public_registry.json.
